item.title: After Some Time
item.description: Its been some time last I posted , I didnt post because there have been no major updates of my work and also I heard that you can now get banned from claude by being rude to the model because it messes up the training data. Jeez ! ,thats too intense. And also my self hosted services have been Pumping the hell out of my RAM and CPU ,So I might consider migrating my services from my Main PC to a home server.Thats all I got to say, Stay Tuned !
